newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CPI rises 0.2 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CPI rises 0.2 percent in March.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.2 percent in March from its February level, official statistics showed on Friday.
It was up 0.8 percent in first quarter 1997, compared with its level last December. The average level of consumer prices in the first quarter was 3.3 percent after 5.0 percent in the same 1996 period
Inflation, measured by the CPI, was 3.7 percent in calendar 1996 after 6.3 percent in 1995.
